team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: 4pc: Light's Guidance — after the equipping character uses an Elemental Skill (off-field allowed), all nearby party members gain a 20% Elemental DMG Bonus for the equipping character's Elemental Type; with Hexerei: Secret Rite active it upgrades to Mortal Hymn, 40% for both the equipping character's and the active character's Elemental Type. The bonus is per element, so enable one condition per Elemental Type it covers. This one grants Pyro DMG Bonus.
